name: Blindspot Check
tagline: What does your website not tell people? Type a domain, see the gaps in a minute.

checks.title: Serves over HTTPS
checks.fix: Redirect http to https and serve a valid certificate.

checks.title: Publishes /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116)
checks.fix: Publish a security.txt with a Contact line so researchers can report a flaw privately.

checks.title: Has an SPF record
checks.fix: Add a TXT record starting v=spf1 that lists who may send mail for the domain.

checks.title: Has a DMARC record
checks.fix: Add a TXT record at _dmarc with at least v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:you@yourdomain.

checks.title: Links a privacy notice from the home page
checks.fix: Say what you keep and link it in the footer.

checks.title: Links terms of use from the home page
checks.fix: Publish terms and link them in the footer.

checks.title: Links an accessibility statement from the home page
checks.fix: Publish an accessibility statement and link it in the footer.
